pharmaceuticals.query: What is the difference between the number of formal meeting requests in the year 2018 and 2010?
pharmaceuticals.answer: The difference between the number of formal meeting requests in 2018 and 2010 is 1,109.
raw_answers:
Based on the bar chart titled CDER PDUFA Formal Meeting Requests by FY, there was a difference of 1,109 formal meeting requests between the years 2018 and 2010.
The chart indicates that in fiscal year 2018, 3,179 formal meeting requests were submitted to CDER. In the fiscal year 2010, there were 2,070 requests. Subtracting the 2010 value from the 2018 value 3,179 - 2,070)results in an increase of 1,109 requests.
